added_failures_note: baseline arm selects nothing: tests/test_oversized_route_replay.py does not exist at ef7d6fd75b (git cat-file -e fails), so the base revision carries no failures in that file; the after arm head.log records '5 passed in 81.94s' with EXIT=0 and no FAILED line, so the delta is zero added failures.

findings.text: the replay calls reckon.mcp_views.section_attempt_count against the live promotion store to warm its cache while the header it prints at replay_oversized_route.py:949 says 'promotion-ledger: not consulted'; that ambient read is what makes a standalone run record EXIT=1 as direct.log does, so the count should be a declared input rather than a read.

this assertion checks that the script printed its own 'reproduced exactly' verdict, which the script emits from a comparison against the constant embedded in itself; it is not independent of the value under test and adds no coverage beyond the row comparison at line 128.

justifications.fit: replay_oversized_route.py:34-40 follows the repo's module idiom and every added filename, function and comment names its behaviour with no plan, issue or version label.
